summary: Frontend-only testing of the new dynamic KPI Company Home (Accueil) registry. Verified layout, testids, gating, empty state, mandate switch, and console cleanliness on persona_finance@accslegro.com/Meelora and admin@accslegro.com/9434 + switch to meelora. Everything renders per spec EXCEPT that clicking a KPI card or a Quick Action does NOT navigate to Ventes & Clients (ar-page). Root cause: destination code mismatch between backend registry and frontend route table.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking kpi-acc.revenue_month (and all other ACCOUNTING KPI cards) as well as quick-action-acc.new_invoice / record_payment / customers / reports does NOT navigate; ar-page never appears. Confirmed: after click, still on company-home, ar-page visible=False.

integration_issues.issue: Backend /app/backend/core/home/registry.py sets destination="acct_sales_ar" for KPIs (lines 146, 150, 154, 158, 160) and quick actions (168, 170, 172, 174) plus recent activity (188, 193, 198). However /app/frontend/src/components/Layout.js only registers route key "acct_sales" (line 63 -> SalesAR/ar-page). No "acct_sales_ar" route exists in the frontend, so useNav().go("acct_sales_ar") silently no-ops. Fix: rename backend destination to "acct_sales" OR add an alias in Layout routes / NavContext.

verified_ok: persona_finance/Meelora: data-testid=company-home + user (Persona E — Responsable financier) + name (meelora) + entrypoint present.
5 KPI cards rendered exactly (kpi-acc.revenue_month, revenue_ytd, open_invoices, collections_month, active_customers) with class 'grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-5'.
company-home-kpi-hint 'KPI affichés selon vos modules et permissions' visible.
company-home-quick-actions with the 4 expected quick-action-acc.* buttons rendered.
company-home-recent contains 6 entries (recent-0..5) with proper colored amounts (paiement vert, note de crédit rouge).

admin/9434-3977 QC inc.: sidebar overlay shows BUDGETS/ACCOUNTING/FIXED_ASSETS/CONSOLIDATION modules but Accueil renders ONLY company-home-no-kpis (Aucun indicateur disponible pour le moment). No KPI cards, no quick-actions, no recent, no info section — no leak, no empty filler cards.

Mandate switcher (data-testid=mandat-switcher / mandat-switch-<id>) works: from admin/9434 -> meelora, active-mandat-name updates and KPI area re-fetches (still empty for admin overlay on meelora, as expected since admin has no operational access).
No console errors on any of the tested screens.
action_items: Fix KPI/QuickAction/Recent destinations: either rename backend destination "acct_sales_ar" to "acct_sales" in /app/backend/core/home/registry.py (lines 146, 150, 154, 158, 160, 168, 170, 172, 174, 188, 193, 198) OR register an alias route "acct_sales_ar" mapping to SalesAR in /app/frontend/src/components/Layout.js. Preferred: align backend to existing frontend key "acct_sales".
critical_code_review_comments: Destination naming should be sourced from a single shared enum/constant to prevent backend↔frontend drift for route keys.
CompanyHome.js line 79 grid reflow logic is fine but does not handle >5 KPIs; registry currently caps at 5 so OK, but add an explicit slice/guard if the registry grows.

success_rate.frontend: 88% (all rendering & gating OK; navigation from KPI/QuickAction broken)

test_credentials: persona_finance@accslegro.com/persona123 (ACCOUNTING on meelora, CHF) and admin@accslegro.com/admin123 (multi-mandats). Both validated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent aligns destination key, re-test: click kpi-acc.revenue_month -> ar-page visible; click quick-action-acc.new_invoice -> ar-page visible. Everything else already validated (layout, testids, empty state on admin/9434, mandate switch reload, no console errors).
rca of the issue: Registry (/app/backend/core/home/registry.py) emits destination="acct_sales_ar" for all ACCOUNTING KPIs, quick actions and recent activity items. Frontend Layout routes map (/app/frontend/src/components/Layout.js line 63) only knows the key "acct_sales" (title 'Ventes & Clients', comp SalesAR which renders data-testid=ar-page). useNav().go("acct_sales_ar") therefore does nothing — the button click handler in CompanyHome.js KpiCard/QuickAction fires but the router does not recognize the destination. Reproduction: login persona_finance/persona123 → click any KPI card or Quick Action → URL/page stays on Accueil, ar-page never mounts. Mitigation: change destination in registry.py to "acct_sales" (single-word), or add `acct_sales_ar: { ...comp: SalesAR }` alias in Layout.js. This impacts KPIs (5), quick actions (4) and recent activity click-throughs (all).
